gaps.sentence: A final decision ___ (MAKE) once the consultation ends.
gaps.explanation: The decision does not make itself: future passive will be made.

gaps.sentence: I need this report ___ by noon, not five.
gaps.explanation: Need + object + past participle: the report is typed by somebody else (causative-like).

gaps.sentence: A cheaper version of the vaccine ___ right now.
gaps.explanation: 'Right now' requires present continuous passive: is being + developed.

gaps.sentence: The new bridge ___ (open) by the mayor next month.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + opened, with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: The rare print ___ (steal) from the locked cabinet — the lock wasn't forced.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive: must have been + past participle for a confident past deduction.

gaps.sentence: By this time tomorrow, the results ___ to every candidate.
gaps.explanation: 'By this time tomorrow' requires future perfect passive: will have been + emailed.

gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.

gaps.sentence: The suspect ___ to have left the country.
